profileFields.brand_narrative_compliance: We balance brand standards with owner economics: proactive QA readiness, PIP execution, and joint decisions with ownership when renovation or revenue trade-offs arise—supported by experience implementing brand capital improvement guidelines across major flags.
profileFields.brand_narrative_relationship: Approved third-party operator for Marriott, Hilton, Hyatt, and IHG in the United States, LATAM, and the Caribbean. Enterprise platform brand experience spans the flags shown in Arbor materials; Arbor Lodging does not currently manage hotels in CALA—this profile reflects team experience and growth pursuit from the Mexico City hub.

relationshipDepth.ownerContext: Strong relationships and years of experience with Marriott, Hilton, Hyatt, and IHG across the U.S. platform—per Arbor ALM materials (slide 19).
Experience implementing PIP programs and complying with brand renovation and capital improvement guidelines; construction and operational excellence awards cited in Arbor materials.
Mexico City hub and approved-operator positioning; pursuing third-party management opportunities—no current CALA managed portfolio on this profile.
40+ renovated and repositioned properties across urban, suburban, resort, and rural settings on the parent platform (ALM deck).
Approved operator positioning in LATAM and Caribbean; relationship-building and feasibility-led growth—confirm live CALA contracts.
